description: Change the band the person is looking at, its name, story, sound or look; the earlier version is kept.

offer.reason: adult on their own written screen with music enabled and a band reference in the message or a band card in the chat

author: MaiPai

examples: rename this band to Night Garden
make the band sound more like early 80s synth pop
change the back story so they met at school
give the band a new portrait

backstory.description: A new back story, 3 to 5 sentences.

sound.description: New style words for the band's songs. Never lyrics.

look.description: What a new portrait should look like. Starts a new portrait.

genres.description: The new genre words, replacing the old ones.

new_portrait.description: True to make a new portrait.

new_logo.description: True to make a new logo.
